title: fix(types,docs): the turned-off sentence and the docs stop pointing at retired Setup pages
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8Y91xTWc4Wtxe392BxMEYRn)_

Fixes #29374

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:动作/流程被关闭时用户看到的那句提示,改为指向现在真实存在的位置(动作 → Setup › Packaged Actions;流程 → Studio 里该包的 Automations);权限文档里指向已退役 Setup 页面的步骤一并改到现在的位置。
- 为什么改:N-28 已退役 Setup › Packaged automation 和 Setup → Access Control 下的 Positions / Permission Sets,文档和报错提示仍把人送去不存在的页面。
- 风险与回滚:只改文字,错误码 `ACTION_DISABLED` / `FLOW_DISABLED` 不变,机器读的是码不是句子;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/types/src/packaged-item-turned-off.ts`(句子本体)、`content/docs/permissions/administrator-guide.mdx`(步骤改写最多)、两份待发布 changeset 的引文改动。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/types exec vitest run src/packaged-item-turned-off.test.ts`,预期 6/6 通过,动作句含 `Setup › Packaged Actions`,流程句含 `Automations in Studio`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(注意 `Check Changeset` 的 empty-changeset 门禁会因改动两份既有待发布 changeset 保持红,见下方 Acceptance notes,需确认)。

## What changes

**Item 3: the turned-off sentence, by kind** (`packages/types/src/packaged-item-turned-off.ts`). The sentence both refusal engines send (`describeTurnedOffPackagedItem`) named the retired Setup › Packaged automation page. It now names where each switch is:

- Action: "This action is turned off for this deployment. An administrator can turn it on again under Setup › Packaged Actions, or you can use another action." The switch is the Setup entry `nav_packaged_actions` (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts`, label `Packaged Actions`). No action-clone offer, as before.
- Flow: "This flow is turned off for this deployment. An administrator can turn it on again in its package's Automations in Studio, or copy it there under a new name." The flow's switch and New similar (the clone door) are on the flow in the package's Automations pillar (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx`, `setupMetadataRedirect.ts` `packagedAutomationStudioPath`), so the "copy it there" clause stays true.

The doc comment no longer calls the page live and explains the two per-kind parts (where, and meanwhile). Plain language, no ADR or tracker number in the runtime string.

**Item 2: docs steps, each confirmed in code** (`content/docs/permissions/`):

- `administrator-guide.mdx` Step 3 (was `:107`): a position's holders are assigned on **Setup → People & Organization → Position Holders** (`nav_position_holders`, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts`; page `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PositionHoldersPage.tsx`). That page's Add writes `user_id` and `position` only (`PositionHoldersSection.tsx`), so the step now says a business-unit anchored assignment is created as a User Position row directly, with `business_unit_id`.
- `administrator-guide.mdx` direct grants (was `:117`): **Setup → People & Organization → Permission Set Assignment** (`nav_permission_set_assignment`; `PermissionSetAssignmentPage.tsx` renders the same `AssignedUsersSection`, titled Assigned Users). Studio's item page shows a link to this Setup page rather than the section (`SetupAssignmentsLink.tsx`), so Setup is where the task is done.
- `administrator-guide.mdx` matrix editor (was `:151`) and `access-recipes.mdx:50`: Studio → All metadata → Permission Set, then open the set (`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, which carries the When (edit) column, `perm.field.when`).
- `administrator-guide.mdx` "Where is everything": definitions and the on/off switch of positions, permission sets and capabilities are in Studio → All metadata; who holds them is the two Setup people pages.
- `authorization.mdx` (was `:251-253`): the catalog list is Studio's All metadata area, `/studio/~all/metadata/permission?scope=environment`, and the old Setup address redirects there (same wording as `permission-sets.mdx:386-387`).

**Item 1: the sweep in other words.** Extra hits added here: `authorization.mdx:33` (capabilities "extended by admins in Setup") and `:419-420` (the on/off switch now sits on the item's page in Studio's All metadata area, per the plugin-security comment above its nav contributions), `delegated-administration.mdx:55` (the Delegated Admin Scope block is in the permission set editor, `PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx`, now in Studio), `capabilities.mdx:124`, `:272` (a capability's label is shown to the administrator who grants it, no longer "in Setup"), and `data-modeling/analytics.mdx:149` (Setup › Datasets: a dataset is metadata, every Setup metadata URL other than a datasource redirects into Studio's All metadata area, `setupMetadataStudioPath`, and no Setup navigation entry names datasets). `skills/**`: zero hits, so this PR touches no governed surface.

**Item 5: the six pinned tests** follow the new sentence. `flow-activation-ledger.test.ts`'s status-disabled check now asserts the message carries no turn-on remedy at all (`not.toContain('turn it on again')`), which still holds whatever page the remedy names. The types test gains one case per kind: the sentence never names Packaged automation.

**Pending changesets.** `.changeset/27842-disabled-actions-served.md` and `.changeset/27966-flow-disabled-plain-sentence.md` are unreleased and quoted the old sentence verbatim; left as they were, the 18.3.0 CHANGELOG would publish a sentence this PR makes false. Only the quoted sentence (and, in 27966, "switched off under Setup › Packaged automation" → "an administrator switched off") changes. The devx seat accepted this widening on the claim (comment 6580761426).

**Platform checklist** (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/`), after #29438 landed and `main` was merged: `api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch` (acceptance[0] clause and verify, acceptance[6] verify) and `automation.packaged-flow-disable-durable` (acceptance[1] clause and verbatim verify, negative[3]) re-point their remedy phrase to the new sentence, and the two TRANSITIONAL known gaps that promised this re-point are retired. Revisions 13 and 10, history rows added.

**Patch changeset** on `@objectstack/types`.

## Why

N-28 (#28578) retired Setup's metadata catalog (Positions, Permission Sets, capabilities, every metadata type except datasource) and the Setup › Packaged automation page (ADR-0146 D1, D4, D11; M-1 ruling 6554738464). A person refused a switched-off action or flow was told to send an administrator to a page that no longer exists, and an administrator following the permissions docs looked for menus that are gone.

## Tests

- Unit, on the merged head: `@objectstack/types` `packaged-item-turned-off.test.ts` 6/6, `@objectstack/objectql` `action-activation.test.ts` 22/22, `@objectstack/runtime` `domains/action-activation-dispatch.test.ts` 12/12, `@objectstack/service-automation` `flow-activation-ledger.test.ts` 49/49, `@objectstack/types` typecheck clean. `@objectstack/types` rebuilt first (downstream tests read its `dist`).
- Dogfood: `api-action-door-forward.dogfood.test.ts` and `packaged-action-disabled-dispatch-live.dogfood.test.ts`, 2 files, 18/18 (head 53a942ac, before the main merge, which did not touch the sentence or these files).
- Reverse check: restoring the old action remedy in `packaged-item-turned-off.ts` (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk, restored to the HEAD blob) turns two types cases red: the byte-for-byte action sentence and the new "never names Packaged automation" case.

## Acceptance notes

- `administrator-guide.mdx:216` (`| Sharing rules, record shares | Setup → Access Control |`) still matches the card's Re-check grep and is left as is: it is correct. `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` still contributes Sharing Rules and Record Shares to Setup's `group_access_control` (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-plugin.ts`).
- The other remaining Re-check hits are intended: `authorization.mdx:254` and `permission-sets.mdx:387` name the old `/apps/setup/metadata/permission` address only to say it redirects to Studio; `packaged-item-turned-off.ts:24` is the doc comment saying the page is retired; `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:755` is item 4, split to #29446 (domain:spec) and not touched here.
- `check-empty-changeset` stays red by design: this PR rewrites two pending release notes that it made false. That is its DELIBERATE CORRECTION case, which asks for confirmation on the PR rather than a restore; restoring them would publish the false sentence.
- Not changed, noted: other pending changesets describe the old page as history (`27842-disabled-actions-beside-item.md`, which belongs with #29446's spec line, `28044-…`, `27504-…`, `27378-…`, `27521-…`, `29139-…`); `ui/packages/**` code comments that name the old page (out of scope per the card); `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/datasetCreate.tsx` still says "Setup › Datasets" in a comment.

## Verification

Derived gate list: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at head ac192301, run locally and reconciled with `--ran`; results and the CI check-runs are in the `os-dev-report` comment on #29374. Docs build and the link check run in CI (`Build Docs`, `check-links.yml`); this PR adds and moves no links.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` untouched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (lint runs in CI)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 block is the maintainer summary the dispatch asks for)
